interface.name: org_kde_kwin_appmenu_manager
interface.description: This interface allows a client to link a window (or wl_surface) to an com.canonical.dbusmenu interface registered on DBus.

request.name: create

description.summary: Create a new appmenu object for the given surface

request.description: Creates a new appmenu object associated with the given surface.

interface.name: org_kde_kwin_appmenu
interface.description: Str, the menu's DBus address. Linked to a wl_surface.

request.name: set_address

description.summary: Set the DBus address of the menu

request.description: Set or update the address of the DBusMenu exported by this client for this surface.
